map.按工况初筛材料示例: Material screening example by operating conditions
map.：过滤「耐高温」得到 PEEK（250–300℃/拉伸强度 90–100 MPa: : filtering "high temperature resistant" yields candidates such as PEEK (250-300 C / tensile strength 90-100 MPa), PPS (200-240 C) and LCP (200-280 C); automotive electronic structural parts often use PPS (corrosion resistant, mid-to-high price), while aviation and medical use PEEK (highest temperature resistance and strength). For soft food-grade needs choose TPE (-50 to 120 C, mid price). GF-reinforced PA/PP trade strength against low cost, suiting industrial structural parts.

map.玻纤增强为什么常用？: Why is glass fiber reinforcement commonly used?
map.玻纤提升拉伸强度、刚度与耐热性并降低收缩率，成本低于特种工程塑料；代价是增加螺杆: Glass fiber raises tensile strength, stiffness and heat resistance and lowers shrinkage at a cost below specialty engineering plastics; the trade-offs are greater screw/mold wear, surface fiber blooming and anisotropy, so leave margin for shrinkage and directional strength in design.
